title: The Long Way Round
prompt: The everything-supplied case: a shot-by-shot script, a character reference and a brand logo, plus the narration the user recorded and the music bed they want under it — five files, and the instruction to lock the length to the audio. The narration is used as recorded (no re-dubbing) and its subtitles come from transcribing that recording, not from the script. The runtime follows it: the supplied speech runs 34.1s, so the film was planned to cover it rather than to the brief's round '30 seconds'. The flask the script is about stays off-screen — only the character and the logo were given as references, and the system did not invent a hero shot for the product.
